{{Quote|Taanab's not much—an ag world whose only redeeming feature is that it sits at the intersection of the Perlemian and the Hapan Spine.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], ''[[Oral History of the New Republic]]''|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The '''Hapan Spine''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that was situated within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It started at the [[Terephon system/Legends|Terephon system]] then connected with the [[Roqoo Depot]] and continued through [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]] until it ended at the beginning of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" />
